why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Everson Pereira is slot #9 (4.197 expected team runs/game).

Primary actual slot #5 ranks 5 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.007 R/G.
Slot #9 yields 3.74 expected PA/game vs 4.19 at primary slot #5. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Power (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models -0.006 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
